title: A temporary network connection
passage:
Woman: We need to replace a network switch on Saturday. Most services will be unavailable from eight until nine in the morning.
Man: Our overseas design team uploads drawings at eight thirty. Can we move the work an hour later?
Woman: The electrician is only available at eight, but I can arrange a temporary connection for the design server.
Man: That would solve the upload problem. Will the video meeting system use that connection too?
Woman: No, only the design server. Please move Saturday's video meeting to nine thirty.
Man: I'll notify the team and send the new meeting invitation.
passageZh:
女：我們星期六需要更換一台網路交換器。大部分服務會在早上八點到九點之間無法使用。
男：我們海外設計團隊會在八點半上傳圖面。能不能把工程延後一小時？
女：電工只有八點有空，但我可以替設計伺服器安排臨時連線。
男：這樣就能解決上傳問題。視訊會議系統也會使用那條連線嗎？
女：不會，只有設計伺服器會用。請把星期六的視訊會議改到九點半。
男：我會通知團隊並寄出新的會議邀請。
